caption: The drawing features a single white cloth, possibly a handkerchief or napkin, placed against a plain, light beige background. The cloth is folded diagonally, forming a triangular shape, and is depicted with intricate detail showing texture and shadows. Along the two shortest sides of the folded edge, there is a wide decorative lace border rendered in fine white lines, creating a netted pattern with small loops and knots. Two parallel lines are drawn near the lace edge on the cloth’s body, indicating stitching or an embroidered border. The overall color palette consists mainly of whites and light grays for the cloth and lace, with some soft shadows accentuating the folds, contrasted against the pale and unobtrusive beige background. There are no additional objects or elements in the drawing.
title: Handkerchief
